comparison_regions.observation: The imported plate-armored knight has a visible helmet/face, articulated gauntlets/legs/boots and a cape at native gameplay scale. The barrel uses a much simpler silhouette. Source PBR response and proportions differ from the compact stylized concept; final toon/outline decisions remain T05 and art approval is pending.

The imported timber barrel is a single simple prop beside the detailed knight and a small peasant hut. Its staves, rim and round mass read at zoom x1. The hut has more texture density than the initial dummy corner; it establishes realistic material/architecture inputs without starting asset-volume production.

Imported boots, barrel, tree trunk and hut foundation meet the plain ground receiver with directional shadows. The hut overlaps the ground and supports wall/roof depth comparison. AO/contact-depth candidates, water and final composition remain later tests; shadow-only depth is not a completed contact-depth effect.

The source tree and thatch/timber materials supply muted greens, stone/beige and wood browns. A procedural sky supplies metal reflections; day/warm/cool comparisons retain source PBR textures. The concept has richer warm amber pools and stylized value separation; the prototype does not claim that match.

proposed_bounds.bound: At zoom x1, distinguish helmet, torso, two boots and at least two of gauntlets/cape/armor plates without zooming; the barrel remains visibly simpler. Compare x2 only as a diagnostic.

Retain 384x216 and ortho 9/4.5. The imported knight uses meter scale; hut/tree display scales 0.5/0.35 fit a small comparison composition. Production proportions and asset pipeline require BW-098 review.

Knight silhouette remains separable from ground, hut and foliage in all three lighting states; boots and building foundations meet the ground, architecture depth is visible, amber light does not erase armor/cape separation.

T04/T09 must show no stationary pixel changes, no repeated crawl/shimmer on rigid edges during slow/diagonal tracking, no one-frame silhouette disappearance or outline-width pumping. One internal-pixel silhouette lines and selective convex highlights are reviewed in T05. No motion pass is claimed in T03.
No filled-surface outlines, stale reflection/depth frames, actor disappearance or unauthorized information in later combined cases; fallback deviations need explicit review.
